Allah established people on earth and made livelihood for them there, yet little are they grateful.
Believers are reminded how Allah sheltered and supported them when they were few and oppressed and provided them good things, so that they might be grateful.
Allah drives ships for people, yet once rescued at sea they ungratefully turn away, though He could drown them; He honored the children of Adam above much of creation.
If people disbelieve Allah is free of need of them, and He does not approve disbelief but approves gratitude; no soul bears another's burden, and all return to Him.
By the panting chargers raising dust at dawn, mankind is ungrateful to his Lord, witnesses it himself and is intense in love of wealth.
